SELECT id, send_history_id, customer_id, final_channel_id, status, cost, user_uuid FROM send_target WHERE id = #{sendTargetId} AND NVL(is_deleted, 0) = 0

#{channelId}
mapper.update:
UPDATE send_history SET status = #{status},
WHERE id = #{sendHistoryId} AND NVL(is_deleted, 0) = 0

UPDATE send_target SET status = #{status}, final_channel_id = #{finalChannelId}, cost = #{cost},
WHERE id = #{sendTargetId} AND NVL(is_deleted, 0) = 0

UPDATE send_history sh SET total_target_count = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM send_target st WHERE st.send_history_id = sh.id AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ), success_count = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM send_target st WHERE st.send_history_id = sh.id AND st.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ), fail_count = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM send_target st WHERE st.send_history_id = sh.id AND st.status IN ('FAILED', 'SKIPPED') AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ), actual_cost = ( SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(st.cost, 0)), 0) FROM send_target st WHERE st.send_history_id = sh.id AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ),
WHERE sh.id = #{sendHistoryId} AND NVL(sh.is_deleted, 0) = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM send_target WHERE send_history_id = #{sendHistoryId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'SENDING') AND NVL(is_deleted, 0) = 0

UPDATE send_history sh SET status = CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM send_target st WHERE st.send_history_id = sh.id AND st.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ) > 0 THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'FAILED' END, completed_at = SYSTIMESTAMP,
WHERE sh.id = #{sendHistoryId} AND NVL(sh.is_deleted, 0) = 0
mapper.select: SELECT st.id, st.send_history_id, st.customer_id, st.final_channel_id, st.status, st.cost, st.user_uuid FROM send_target st JOIN send_history sh ON sh.id = st.send_history_id AND NVL(sh.is_deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE st.status = 'PENDING' AND sh.status = 'SCHEDULED' AND sh.scheduled_at IS NOT NULL AND sh.scheduled_at <= SYSTIMESTAMP AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ORDER BY sh.scheduled_at ASC, st.id ASC
